voice.assistants.details.cameraAccess.gr: 🔒 Your live view will be encrypted end-to-end.
If you’ve already granted SmartThings Camera access but are experiencing issues, try granting access again.
Don't see your live view in SmartThings?

Granting Camera access to $partnerName$ lets you see your camera's live view in the $partnerName$ app and on connected devices.

<emph>How it works</emph>
The Hue app automatically encrypts the live view of your Secure cameras. When you grant Camera access, your $partnerName$ app and its connected devices receive the encryption key to display your encrypted live stream.

If you decide to revoke Camera access, $partnerName$ won't be able to display your live view in its app or on connected devices.
Grant Camera access to let $partnerName$ display your Secure camera's live view in the $partnerName$ app and on connected devices.
